panels.description: The Nexus lower corridor floods around the archive case. Meltwater freezes at the edges while blue ice shears overhead. Keep the escape route visible. Reserve upper-left for the structural sound and upper-right for Nayah's balloon, with separate space near the shearing ice for the SFX.
Nayah pulls Orien along the safety line. Roman carries only the selected physical evidence package, visibly marked essential; Sitara follows with her separate TJ. No one turns back. Keep silent.

Roman's field tablet shows a clearly labeled remote operational record feed from the separate FALCON site receiving the authenticated evidence package. Show data only, never Falcon physically visible from Nexus. Leave upper-left clear.

Falcon's local safety console shows an authenticated inspection interlock and drilling hold pending local safety response. Include a small local operator or automatic safety acknowledgment. Reserve separate upper-left for the hold status, lower-right for the acknowledgment, and lower-left for the structural SFX.

items.speaker: NAYAH
items.text: Evacuate. Leave anything you cannot carry.
AUTHENTICATED INSPECTION INTERLOCK / LOCAL CONTROL FLAGGED
DRILLING HOLD PENDING LOCAL SAFETY RESPONSE
